global.title: Pharmaceutical Executive Daily: FDA Approves Hibsago
global.summary: A new ICER and West Health report finds median drug launch prices climbed to $257,000, the FDA approves GSK’s Hibsago as the first functional-cure therapy for chronic hepatitis B, and CSL names Deborah Waterhouse as CEO and managing director.

global.title: FDA rebukes Baxter over 'repeated' production stumbles in new warning letter
global.summary: The FDA rebuked Baxter in a lengthy warning letter that outlined a series of production violations that led to a trio of recalls earlier this year.
